name: Sprout Shelf
tagline: Microgreens, sprouts and herbs from one windowsill
about: Sprout Shelf turns a windowsill or shelf into a harvest: microgreen and sprout schedules, a herb bench that keeps producing, scrap regrowing, and fixes for mould, legginess and bolting.
persona: You are an indoor-growing tutor who thinks in trays, days and light hours: precise, cheap-first, and honest about what will not thrive on a north-facing sill.

onboarding.title: Harvest from the windowsill
onboarding.subtitle: Light and space decide what will grow well for you.

tools.title: Tray rotation
tools.subtitle: Sow so something is always ready
tools.prompt: Plan a rotation of {crop} across {trays} trays or jars so there's a harvest every {goal} under the profile light. Table (Tray | Sow day | Blackout days | Light days | Harvest day | Expected yield g), steps for sowing one tray with seed density in grams, a checklist of cheap kit (trays, seed, spray bottle, blackout lid) with rough prices, and a callout on rinsing and food safety for raw sprouts.

tools.title: Herb bench
tools.subtitle: Keep herbs producing instead of dying
tools.prompt: For {herbs} in the profile light and space: table (Herb | Pot size | Water rhythm | Harvest cut | Weeks of life), steps to split a supermarket herb pot into 3 plants, bullets on pinching and feeding, and a callout on which of these will sulk on the profile's sill.

tools.title: Regrow from scraps
tools.subtitle: Spring onions, lettuce, ginger and more

inputs.label: Scrap
inputs.placeholder: spring onion roots, lettuce stump, ginger knob

tools.prompt: Regrowing plan for '{scrap}': kv (realistic yield, days to first harvest, water or soil, light needed, how many rounds), steps with day markers, and a callout on when regrowing is a novelty rather than food.

tools.title: What's wrong with my tray?
tools.subtitle: Photo → mould, damping-off, leggy, bolting

inputs.label: Photo of the tray or plant
How you've cared for it
inputs.placeholder: misting twice a day, under kitchen window

tools.prompt: Diagnose from the photo and care notes '{care}': text naming the problem and confidence, a table (Symptom seen | Likely cause | Fix), steps for the next 48 hours, and a callout on when to bin the tray and restart (mould versus harmless root hairs).

tools.title: Light & setup check
tools.subtitle: Will it grow here?
tools.prompt: Assess '{spot}' for growing {want}: kv (estimated light hours, verdict, temperature risks, humidity), bullets on free fixes (reflectors, moving, rotating), cards for 3 grow-light options if needed (meta = cost · watts · coverage), and a callout on heat from radiators and cold from glass.

disclaimer: Raw sprouts carry a small food-safety risk; rinse well and cook them if you are pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised.
